title: Migraine predicted effector genes (Hautakangas H et al. 2022)
bodyHtml:
This table displays results from the study:

Genome-wide analysis of 102,084 migraine cases identifies 123 risk loci and subtype-specific risk alleles.
Hautakangas H, et al.
Nat Genet. 2022 Feb;54(2):152-160. doi: 10.1038/s41588-021-00990-0.
PMID: 35115687

The authors performed a GWAS meta-analysis for migraine in 102,084 cases and 771,257 control subjects, all of European ancestry, then performed eQTL mapping for the 123 lead variants using gene expression levels from GTEx v8. Genes were prioritized at the risk loci using FOCUS (fine-mapping of causal gene sets) and by transcriptome-wide association study (TWAS) using S-PrediXcan with colocalization (using COLOC).

The table below lists genes that were prioritized by either or both of the two methods. Mouse over the column headers for more details about each evidence type.
